title: German Scientists Seek Public’s Help to Count Insects This Summer (1/2)
titleZh: 德國科學家邀請民眾今夏一起數昆蟲 (1/2)
summaryZh: 德國團體號召民眾在夏天數算身邊的昆蟲，協助科學家觀察氣候變遷的影響。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Science & Technology

sentences.text: How many insects can you count in one hour?
sentences.zh: 一個小時內你能數出多少隻昆蟲？

sentences.text: That was the question being asked by a group of environmentalists outside of Berlin's Natural History Museum recently.
sentences.zh: 最近一群環保人士就在柏林自然史博物館外提出了這個問題。

sentences.text: The Nature and Biodiversity Conservation Union, or NABU,
sentences.zh: 自然與生物多樣性保護聯盟，簡稱 NABU，

sentences.text: is asking regular people to help count the insects they see in any 10-meter area available to them.
sentences.zh: 正邀請一般民眾幫忙數算他們在任何十公尺範圍內看到的昆蟲。
NABU 主辦了「昆蟲之夏」活動。

sentences.text: It is now in its seventh year.
The effort is a way to follow the movements of insects, such as aphids, ladybugs, and bees.
sentences.zh: 這項活動可以用來追蹤蚜蟲、瓢蟲和蜜蜂等昆蟲的動向。

sentences.text: Laura Breitkreutz is an expert on insects and biodiversity at NABU.
sentences.zh: Laura Breitkreutz 是 NABU 的昆蟲與生物多樣性專家。

sentences.text: She said, the project helps scientists observe the effects of climate change.
sentences.zh: 她說，這個計畫能幫助科學家觀察氣候變遷帶來的影響。

sentences.text: We have seen that a few insects that normally occur only in the south might be spreading further north, she said, noting the appearance of the violet carpenter bee in Germany.
sentences.zh: 她說：「我們發現有些原本只出現在南方的昆蟲，可能正在往北擴散。」並提到紫木蜂已經在德國現蹤。

sentences.text: The Citizen Science Project aims to give researchers information.
sentences.zh: 這項公民科學計畫的目的是提供研究人員資訊。

sentences.text: It is not like precise scientific observations.
sentences.zh: 它並不像精準的科學觀測那樣嚴謹。

sentences.text: However, the discoveries of regular people can give formal researchers unexpected insights.
sentences.zh: 不過，一般民眾的發現可以給專業研究人員意想不到的啟發。

sentences.text: From bees to butterflies, scientists consider insects an important part of the ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 從蜜蜂到蝴蝶，科學家都認為昆蟲是生態系裡重要的一環。

sentences.text: They are important to pollination, the food chain, and keeping soil productive.
sentences.zh: 牠們對授粉、食物鏈和維持土壤肥沃都很重要。
